title: Dinosaur Coloring Book for Kids Ages 3-6, 30 Printable Pages, Easy & Playful Scenes, Color Examples, A4 & Letter PDF
description:
Bring a little dinosaur coloring time to your day: 30 friendly designs for ages 3-6, plus two optional colored examples with simple color palettes.

Start with 15 Easy designs with large open areas, or choose from 15 Engaging scenes with playful details. Find friendly dinosaurs at a party, on a picnic and on little imaginative adventures.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE — FOUR PDF FILES
1. A4 coloring book: 31 pages — one cover and 30 black-and-white coloring designs.
2. US Letter coloring book: 31 pages — the same cover and 30 designs.
3. A4 Color Inspiration: 2 pages — two colored examples with color palettes.
4. US Letter Color Inspiration: 2 pages — the same two examples.

Paper sizes: A4 (210 x 297 mm) and US Letter (8.5 x 11 inches).
Both sizes contain the same artwork. This is 30 unique coloring designs, not 60. The color examples show two of the included designs; they are not additional line-art designs.

COLOR YOUR OWN WAY
The examples suggest three colors for one Easy design and six colors for a party scene. Any similar crayons or colored pencils can be used. Children are welcome to choose different colors. View the examples on a screen to save color ink.

PRINTING
Choose the PDF matching your paper. Print in portrait at Actual Size / 100%. The coloring pages can be printed in black-and-white. One-sided printing is suggested. You do not need a color printer for the coloring pages.

DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical book, printed pages, crayons or pencils are shipped. These are PDF files, not editable templates. PNG and SVG source files are not included in the buyer download. A PDF viewer and access to a printer are needed to print the pages.

ABOUT THE ART
Friendly cartoon dinosaurs and imaginary scenes are intended for creative coloring. Some species appear in more than one distinct scene. This is not a set of 30 different species or a scientific reconstruction. Adult supervision is recommended.

USE
For one household or one educator in one classroom. Print copies for your own children or students. Do not resell, redistribute or share the digital files.

AI DISCLOSURE
The illustrations and colored examples were created with AI assistance, then selected, revised, prepared as printable files and checked. The color examples are digital illustrations, not photographs of a child's coloring.

HELP WITH YOUR FILES
If a file will not open or an included page appears incorrect, contact PoonthaiDigital through Etsy with the filename and page number so we can investigate. Please avoid sending children's names or photos.
